_about: Scene rows (RSDB/EventSetting __RowId) that nothing in the game names, recomputed. Method: every row id was looked for as a whole identifier token ([A-Za-z0-9_]+, so a path such as Work/Event/EventSetting/<row>.engine__event__EventSettingParam.gyml in an NPC's AIScheduleParam and a flag name such as HavePlayedEvent.<row> both count) in every game file, read as vanilla (./original copies win), .zs files decompressed and SARC packs expanded to their members (nested): event flows, every actor-pack member (AIScheduleParam and the rest), level files, AI/Logic/Sequence graphs, GameParameter, text archives, effects, SLink2/ELink2, camera animations, RSDB tables, and the game executable (builds/rc/image.bin). Skipped as asset data only: Model, Tex, Shader, Sound, Movie, Voice, Font2, TerrainArc, PreComputedCulling, Bake. A row's own record in RSDB/EventSetting and RSDB/GameAnalyzedEventInfo, and its own RSDB/GameEventMetadata record (named after it: TreasureBoxAppear_Any_Magic, TreasureBoxAppear_Fall), don't count. scanned_files counts files and pack members. The previous version (742 rows) over-counted: it missed references by path inside packs (710 of its rows are named by NPC talk schedules, Component/AIScheduleParam/*, e.g. Npc_Hylia_024_D_T) and the executable (GossipStone_ReceiveSwordDamageByPlayer). Unreferenced is not the same as free: template rows (BancChange*_Base, DefaultBoss*Event, PlayOcarina_*, TitleEventBase, Npc_*_Base) may be started by code through their type; 13 rows here are songs_trade's save flags (data/rando/songs_trade_flags.json). Scanner: scratch rows/scan.py of the extras_npcs work.
